applicableAreas: Buildings 1-8 and their exterior wall faces and projections relative to overhead electric conductors
findings.comment: Site plan shows overhead electric (OHE) lines along property boundaries and transformer pad location, but no surveyed elevation data for conductors and no building elevation sheets with clearance dimension annotations are provided. Cannot verify that buildings and permanent structures maintain the required 7 feet 6 inches horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from overhead electric conductors without registered surveyor elevation data and dimensioned building elevation drawings.

applicableAreas: Buildings 1-8 and transformer pads relative to overhead distribution conductors
findings.comment: Overhead electric lines and transformer pad are shown on site plan, but no radial clearance dimension annotations from outside conductors to buildings or facilities are provided. No surveyed conductor locations or voltage class designations visible. Cannot verify 15-foot radial clearance from outside conductor of overhead distribution primary and neutral conductors without dimensioned clearance exhibits.

applicableAreas: Building faces and roofline projections (overhangs, awnings, balconies, canopies) relative to overhead electric lines
findings.comment: No building elevation sheets or section views provided showing building projections (overhangs, awnings, balconies, decks, roofs, patios) relative to overhead electric conductors. Without surveyed overhead conductor elevations and dimensioned clearances on elevation or section drawings, compliance with 7.5-foot sky-to-ground and 15-foot radial clearances from projections cannot be verified.

applicableAreas: All proposed buildings within potential clearance distance of overhead electric facilities
findings.comment: No building elevation sheets are provided in the site plan set. Surveyed elevations and locations of overhead electric conductors cannot be verified as included on building elevation sheets because no such sheets exist. Building elevation sheets with surveyed conductor elevation data and clearance dimension annotations are required to demonstrate required clearances are met.

applicableAreas: All buildings and permanent structures on site (Bldgs 1-8)
findings.comment: Site plan and electrical design plan do not include section or enlarged plan view exhibits with dimension lines showing clearances from outer electric conductor to outermost edge of buildings and building projections. Clearance verification dimensions required by UCM § 1.10.3 are absent from all submitted plan sheets.

applicableAreas: Concrete retaining walls located along NE, East, SE, and S property boundaries
findings.comment: Retaining walls are shown on grading plan (Sheet 11) and wall plan (Sheet 38-39) with wall heights up to 14 feet maximum. Overhead electric lines are shown along the South, East, and West property boundaries (Sheet 9, 21), but no clearance dimensions from retaining wall faces/tops to outside electric lines are provided. Wall plan does not depict overhead electric lines or clearance annotations required to verify 7.5-foot sky-to-ground clearance.

applicableAreas: Concrete retaining walls along property perimeter
findings.comment: Wall plan sheets (38-39) provide wall cross-section details but contain no section exhibits showing clearance dimensions from outer electric conductor to retaining wall faces. Overhead electric lines and conductor locations are not depicted on wall plan sheets.

applicableAreas: Driveways and parking areas where overhead electric lines traverse or are adjacent
findings.comment: Grading plan and electrical design plan show driveway and parking grades and overhead electric lines, but no vertical clearance dimensions are provided from lowest overhead electric facility (including any telecommunications attachments) to finished driveway/parking grades. Finished grades shown but no surveyor mid-span clearance verification provided. Cannot verify 16-foot (parking without trucks) or 18-foot (with truck traffic) minimum vertical clearance.

applicableAreas: Biofiltration/detention pond in NE portion of site and associated retaining walls within electric easement zones
findings.comment: Site plan shows biofiltration/detention pond in northeast corner of site where multiple easements exist, including electric easements. Sheet 3 Block 20 note 16 prohibits detention ponds which would impair Austin Energy's access to transmission easements. No clearance dimensions from pond or pond retaining walls to overhead electric facilities or easement boundaries are provided to verify 7.5-foot clearance from outside conductor to pond structures.

applicableAreas: Entire site where vertical clearance from overhead facilities to proposed site features (driveways, parking, buildings) appears potentially marginal
findings.comment: Overhead electric lines and poles are visible on site plans with multiple facilities crossing over driveways, parking areas, and located adjacent to buildings (Transformer Pad near Bldg 2, OHE lines along property boundaries). No registered surveyor data showing pole locations and mid-span clearances is provided. Based on site plan scale and proximity of poles/lines to structures, vertical clearance verification by registered surveyor with mid-span clearance documentation is required but not submitted.

applicableAreas: Proposed tree mitigation plantings along south and east property boundaries near overhead electric distribution lines
findings.comment: Landscape plan (Sheet 31) shows proposed mitigation trees (labeled 'M') planted directly adjacent to overhead electric (OHE) line along the southern boundary with no clearance dimensions annotated. Proposed tree species per plant list (Sheet 35) include Live Oak and Cedar Elm - both large shade trees with mature heights of 40-50+ feet, exceeding the 20-foot maximum for utility-compatible trees. These non-utility-compatible species are placed within the required clearance zone without proper spacing or UC designation. No horizontal or vertical clearance dimensions provided.

applicableAreas: Cover sheet and general notes for the site plan
findings.comment: Cover sheet (Sheet 1) does not include the required note that owner/contractor must notify Austin Energy at least 48 hours before work begins near high-voltage overhead lines per Texas Health & Safety Code Chapter 752, Section 752.003. While Sheet 3 Block 20 includes a 48-hour pre-construction safety meeting requirement specific to transmission structures, the required general notification note covering all overhead electric lines must appear on the cover sheet or general notes.
